_comment: S3 identities for the local SeaweedFS dev stack. Credentials match the
This file is why the service is started with -s3.config. WITHOUT it,
`weed server -s3` accepts ANY credentials and serves objects to
unsigned, anonymous requests -- a presigned-URL bug would pass locally
and fail only in production. With it, SeaweedFS behaves like real S3:
anonymous GET is 403 and a tampered signature is rejected.
Local dev only. Stage and prod set no AWS_S3_ENDPOINT and talk to real
AWS S3, so nothing here is deployed anywhere.
